theme: 3 terms on notifications: the alert the app schedules itself, the alert a server sends, and the in-app message system that users never see

terms.definition: An alert your app schedules on the device itself, for a time or a place, with no server involved.
terms.example: The workout reminder is a Local Notification, it works in airplane mode.

terms.definition: An alert your server sends through Apple's push service to a user's device.
terms.example: The chat message arrives as a Push Notification from our server.

terms.definition: In code, the `NotificationCenter` object that broadcasts messages between parts of your app; users never see these.
terms.example: Post to Notification Center when the cart changes, so the badge updates.

video.title: Local Notification, Push Notification & Notification Center | Day 94
video.description:
Learn to explain the different kinds of notifications in iOS: Local Notification, Push Notification & Notification Center, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Local Notification - An alert your app schedules on the device itself, for a time or a place, with no server involved.
Push Notification - An alert your server sends through Apple's push service to a user's device.
Notification Center - In code, the `NotificationCenter` object that broadcasts messages between parts of your app; users never see these.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

landscape.title: iOS Local Notification, Push Notification & Notification Center | Day 94
landscape.description:
Explain Local Notification, Push Notification & Notification Center in UIKit by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
로컬 알림, 푸시 알림, 노티피케이션 센터 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

Local Notification - An alert your app schedules on the device itself, for a time or a place, with no server involved.
한국어: 로컬 알림: 서버 없이 앱이 기기 안에서 시간이나 장소를 정해 예약하는 알림

Push Notification - An alert your server sends through Apple's push service to a user's device.
한국어: 푸시 알림: 서버가 Apple의 푸시 서비스를 통해 사용자 기기로 보내는 알림

Notification Center - In code, the `NotificationCenter` object that broadcasts messages between parts of your app; users never see these.
한국어: 노티피케이션 센터: 코드에서 앱의 여러 부분 사이에 메시지를 방송하는 `NotificationCenter` 객체로, 사용자에게는 보이지 않음

landscape.hook: You posted a notification, but no banner shows. Can you explain why in English?

dialogue.title: Where is my banner?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, `remind` posts to Notification Center, but no banner ever shows.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That Notification Center only talks between objects inside the app. Users never see it.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Oh. So how do I show a real banner?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Schedule a Local Notification with `UNUserNotificationCenter`. iOS shows it at the right time.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Even if the app is closed?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. The system delivers it, no server needed.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Then when do we need a Push Notification?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: When the server knows something new, like a message from a friend.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: And a Push Notification needs the device token?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Right, plus permission. Both kinds need the user to allow alerts.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Got it. Local Notification for reminders, Notification Center for messages inside the app.
No server, no internet, a Local Notification still fires.
